triples.tail_surface: Keep pump as clean as possible
triples.evidence_text: Keep pump as clean as possible. This will facilitate inspection, adjustment and repair work and help prevent overlooking a dirt covered grease fitting.

triples.head_surface: overlooking a dirt covered grease fitting
triples.head_canonical_zh: 忽略被污垢覆盖的润滑脂接头
triples.tail_surface: Keep pump as clean as possible
triples.evidence_text: Keep pump as clean as possible. This will facilitate inspection, adjustment and repair work and help prevent overlooking a dirt covered grease fitting.

triples.tail_surface: drained and a light coat of non-detergent SAE 30 weight oil must be applied to all internal pump parts
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 排空并在所有内部泵部件涂覆一层轻质非洗涤剂SAE 30机油
triples.evidence_text: If pump is to be stored, or not used for six months or more, pump must be drained and a light coat of non-detergent SAE 30 weight oil must be applied to all internal pump parts.

triples.tail_surface: Lubricate fittings and apply grease to pump shaft extension
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 润滑接头并向泵轴伸出端涂抹润滑脂
triples.evidence_text: Lubricate fittings and apply grease to pump shaft extension.

triples.tail_surface: rotating pump shaft by hand one complete revolution every 30 days to circulate the oil
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 每30天手动旋转泵轴一整圈以循环润滑油
triples.evidence_text: Viking suggests rotating pump shaft by hand one complete revolution every 30 days to circulate the oil.

triples.tail_surface: Tighten all pump assembly bolts before putting pump in service after being stored
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 储存后投用前拧紧所有泵组件螺栓
triples.evidence_text: Tighten all pump assembly bolts before putting pump in service after being stored.

triples.head_surface: excessive leakage or damage to pump
triples.tail_surface: be sure circulation connections are connected to the suction or discharge port as noted above
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 确保循环连接按上述说明连接到吸入或排出口
triples.evidence_text: If pump rotation is reversed, be sure circulation connections are connected to the suction or discharge port as noted above to avoid excessive leakage or damage to pump.

triples.tail_surface: Relief valve adjusting screw cap must always point towards suction side of pump
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 安全阀调节螺帽必须始终指向泵的吸入侧
triples.evidence_text: Relief valve adjusting screw cap must always point towards suction side of pump.
